messages:
chris (partnerships): Heads up — Acme HW wants a marketplace listing + joint announcement. They asked for SOC2 summary, latest pen-test, and a completed security questionnaire. Need owners for artifacts, redaction, and PR timeline. cc @devon @priya @matt

devon (security): We can supply a SOC2 summary + a redacted pen-test bundle. Question: do they require an independent retest or will our last 3rd-party pen (Jan 2026) suffice? Also need to know which questionnaire template they expect.

priya (legal): We cannot publish full pen-test PDFs externally. We'll provide presigned S3 links behind an NDA + access TTL. Recommend 30-day presign window and a single-access audit log. I'll draft the access addendum.

matt (eng): I can prepare a redacted bundle and upload to evidence bucket. ETA EOD Thu for initial bundle. I'll gzip and sha256 it: `pen-test-2026-redacted.pdf.gz` + `.sha256`.

sarah (product): Acme wants to coordinate with their partner summit on 2026-04-14. Does that mean PR + marketplace listing need to be live same day?

devon (security): If summit is 4/14 we should freeze artifacts by 2026-04-01 to leave 2 weeks for legal/security review and any re-redactions. Also want to run a light internal smoke pentest on the HW integration before listing. @alex can your team run this?

alex (eng-runtime): We can do a 2-hour smoke window next week. Need the devkit in our lab and a contact for device serials. @chris can you confirm shipping/tracking?

chris (partnerships): Confirmed — Acme ships devkit tomorrow via DHL. Tracking: https://dhl.example/track/ABC12345. @alex please coordinate with @jules for receiving and storage.

priya (legal): Using our standard evidence access template: https://confluence.redwood/integrations/evidence-access-template — will add clause prohibiting redistribution and require NDA signer. Also need to check export controls for any HW firmware.

devon (security): Pen-test scoping: do we allow network-level probing of the devkit from outside our lab? If it stays on our internal VLAN we can allow limited blackbox scans but not full network DoS tests. Need explicit scoping doc.

sarah (product): Proposed timeline: artifacts ready 2026-04-01, internal signoff 2026-04-06, marketplace listing ready 2026-04-10, PR draft 2026-04-11, embargoed announce 2026-04-14 10:00 PT. Thoughts? :calendar:

matt (eng): I'll upload artifact paths: `s3://redwood-evidence/acme/hw-integration/pen-test-2026-redacted.pdf.gz` and `s3://redwood-evidence/acme/hw-integration/soc2-summary.txt`. Presign CLI I plan to run: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/acme/pen-test-2026-redacted.pdf.gz --expires-in 2592000`.

devon (security): Redaction checklist (short): remove AWS account IDs, internal IPs, employee usernames, full stack traces, and any partner customer data. Quick grep for AWS IDs: `grep -Eo '([0-9]{12})' -R .` — run before upload.

jules (eng-infra): If external scans are in scope, open a ticket with tag `ext-pen-test` and include date/time + source IPs so cloudops can whitelist and capture VPC flow logs. Also route to SOC for increased alerting.

chris (partnerships): I'll own partner comms + PR draft. @lisa, can marketing prepare a one-pager and social assets for the embargo time above?

lisa (marketing): Yep — standby. Share 3 bullet points, approved customer quote (if available), embargo time, and logo assets. We can turn a draft in 48 hours.

devon (security): SI questionnaire: I'll populate our answers and push a redacted copy by 2026-04-02 for legal review. If Acme wants more depth on runtime isolation / KMS/HSM usage, I'll include diagrams.

chris (partnerships): Next action items — @matt upload redacted bundle (due 2026-04-01), @devon provide redacted questionnaire (due 2026-04-02), @priya draft access addendum (due 2026-03-30), @jules open infra ticket if external scans needed. I'll sync with Acme on shipment + embargo.

deploy-bot: Pen-test smoke window request created (ticket #INC-6578) — please add owners and window in the ticket.

matt (eng): Added files and presigns to the ticket. Leaving a note with checksum and redaction log.

priya (legal): I'll circulate the NDA + access addendum for signatures once I have the final artifact list.

chris (partnerships): Thanks all — I'll do a partner-facing summary after EOD. :thumbsup:
